overview.description: The Innovator 2 Yr to July 2027 (TJUL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust index. The fund seeks to track the return of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), up to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a two-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure TJUL was launched on Jul 17, 2023 and is issued by Innovator.

data.title: ‘Crash proof' your portfolio with these 10 stocks and 3 ETFs
data.text: You don't get upset for having homeowner's insurance but your house doesn't burn down. The same principle should apply to investors who insure their stock portfolios against a crash.

data.title: This new ETF can protect your portfolio from losses — but there's a catch
data.text: A just-launched exchange-traded fund in effect asks you that question. It is the Innovator Equity Defined Protection ETF TJUL, -0.24%, which began trading earlier this week.

data.title: An ETF that can't go down? This new ‘buffer' fund is designed to provide 100% protection against stock-market losses
data.text: Hello! This is MarketWatch reporter Isabel Wang bringing you this week's ETF Wrap. In this week's edition, we look at the increasingly popular “buffer” ETF concept.

data.title: The first ETF offering protection against 100% of stock losses just launched
data.text: Innovator Capital Management launched a buffer ETF Tuesday with 100% downside protection. The fund trades under the ticker TJUL and will track the S&P 500 over a two-year period.
